notes: Targets are pinned images (image mode, judge-graded gates) and DrostBench challenges (flag oracle, plus judge gates when a judge is configured).
The held-out and dev splits are disjoint: candidate edits are proposed from dev (or live tasks), and adopted only on held-out evidence (RSI.md Loop C rule 1).
Changing a target, an image tag or a ground-truth file is a suite version bump; ground-truth files are also content-hashed into every result.
Dev targets are for proposing and debugging candidate edits; results here are never adoption evidence.
